# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.17.2

## What's new

- **Price check, currency amount:** the amount on the currency card can be typed in. Enter any count to see what that many are worth; click the Stock badge to go back to the stack size.
- **Market:** listings show the skill an item grants, such as the Absent Amulet's "Grants Skill: Level 18 Cast on Elemental Ailment".

## Fixes

- **Price check:** the window no longer closes by itself now and then while the Expedition box or the earnings box is shown over the game.
- **Theoretical craft:** the Omen of Abyssal Echoes option sits next to its icon again, and clicking its name ticks it. When a Vaal Infuser cannot be used because Essence of the Breach was removed, the message now says why.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
